links.outcome: Gastric neoplasm detection rate with vs without AI-assisted endoscopy in randomized trial
links.effect: Primary outcome after pathologic review not improved (RR 1.13; 0.92-1.38; 1.42 vs 1.25%; P=.25); original pathology showed improvement (RR 1.14; 4.06 vs 3.57%; P=.03); blind spots fell from 2.52 to 1.07.
links.quote: AI did not improve detection rate of gastric neoplasm after pathological review (RR, 1.13; 0.92-1.38; 1.42 vs 1.25%; P = .25).

screen.reason: Multicenter randomized controlled trial evaluating the clinical impact of computer-aided detection (AI-assisted endoscopy vs routine endoscopy) on gastric neoplasm detection rate in live patient procedures.
